title: Macizm releases his recent track titled “God Send”
htmlContent:
As the saying goes, "Loyalty Before Royalty" talented music star Macizm is a multi-talented singer and songwriter from North Carolina. The music star has taken out time to learn all there is to know about his craft. His talent shines bright in releasing his recent "God Send" track.

The way is all about romanticizing the day you meet your twin flame, and he reimagined everything you thought you knew about love was reimagined through this new connection. In releasing his recent track "God Send," Macizm graced us with his euphoric melodies and breathtaking neo-soul vocal execution. Here he finds a floating point amid the beat to give us the vibe we have been looking for.
